canonical_project: Ganzhou municipal cloud-computing data-center estate (Tianyi Huawei Cloud, Mobile Inspur Cloud, Gannan Data Lake)
owner: China Telecom / Huawei, China Mobile / Inspur, Gannan Data Lake operators
notes: Ganzhou administrative approval bureau response states the city had three municipal cloud-computing data centers with 451 racks total: Tianyi Huawei Cloud 104, Mobile Inspur Cloud 105 and Gannan Data Lake 242, with total machine-room area 5,300 sq m.
